description: Scan MCP servers for potential threats & security findings.

written.description: Judges an MCP server's tool definitions three ways, by YARA rule, by hosted inspection API and by asking a model, so a poisoned tool description has to clear more than one kind of reader.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(scanner): fall back to initialize() when a legacy HTTP server rejects the 2026-07-28 protocol version (#296)

MCP TypeScript SDK servers that predate the 2026-07-28 protocol answer the server/discover request with -32600 "Bad Request: Unsupported protocol version: 2026-07-28. Supported versions: ..." and still accept the legacy initialize() handshake. The legacy-HTTP fallback only accepted "Bad Request: Missing session ID", so remote scans of these servers (for example mcp.deepwiki.com) failed where 4.3.x scanned them. Accept that rejection too, for legacy HTTP only, and keep other -32600 errors fatal.

Co-authored-by: Harish <hsanthan@cisco.com>
